overview: Bunbohue65 Ship is a Bún Bò Huế 65 ordering app with QR payment and delivery, now adding enterprise-level role-based device management with three business roles: payment queue, accounting, and sales & promo reporting.
features: Manage devices by enterprise roles attached via activation codes
Payment queue role to view and process pending payment orders
Accounting role for manual order cleanup, manual invoice issuance, and order lookup with payment verification images
Sales and promo reporting role combining promotion management, promo tracking, and sales analytics
